That's just what I hoped for. I saved the search as "Accessible design," and once I was back in my normal library it was sitting there under "Saved searches" in the sidebar — one click brought back the very same combined conditions and results. And I like that it's holding onto the *conditions*, not a frozen snapshot, so anything I save later that fits will just show up when I open it. That means the searches I lean on are always a click away and stay current. This settles the save-a-search piece for me.

That leaves just the comfort settings — how many bookmarks show at once, the text size, and which order my list defaults to. Could we do that last one next?
